meta.title: Ondra Screen Sense
meta.description: Screen presence for Ondra (L9 extension pool, thin wrapper): it answers one question — does she roughly know what her owner is working with right now? Only at category level (coding, writing, reading, meeting, media, browsing, gaming, idle, unreadable), and only when the category can actually be read. It never captures the screen, never runs OCR, never records: capture needs system permissions and native modules and belongs to the app shell, while the vision service takes an image path, which would mean writing frames to disk and sending them out — this plugin touches none of that and only accepts categories the shell has already classified. Three hard rules: unreadable is not absent (two separate states, and elapsed time is null rather than zero when nothing could be read); jitter never ends a segment (a category replaced before the stability window only counts as a handover, the current segment stays); nothing in the state file can reconstruct what the owner was looking at (timestamps and counters only — no titles, app names, paths, URLs or captures). Of the nine categories only three can ever speak, and only when one thing has been sustained long enough; during a meeting, during media, while switching, while away and while unreadable it says nothing at all. Elapsed minutes come from the health guard's snapshot rather than a second calculation. No UI, no timers, and it never sends anything on its own.
